settings.title: Cloudflare R2
settings.description: Where Medusa stores uploaded files: product images, import/export files, anything that goes through the File Module.
settings.saved: Settings saved. Uploads use them right away, no restart needed.

status.provider_missing: medusa-config.ts does not register this provider in the File Module yet: add medusa-storage-r2/providers/r2 (see the README). Settings can be saved, but uploads keep going to the current provider.

settings.account_id_hint: Cloudflare dashboard → R2 → Overview, right-hand column. 32 hex characters.
settings.jurisdiction_hint: Only when the bucket was created with a jurisdiction (EU or FedRAMP).
settings.endpoint_hint: Derived from the account ID. Fill in only for another S3-compatible store (MinIO, …).
settings.credentials_hint: R2 → Manage R2 API Tokens → Create API Token, permission Object Read & Write, scoped to this bucket. Both halves are saved together, encrypted with R2_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

encryption_status.ok: Credentials are stored encrypted and readable.
encryption_status.missing: R2_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set on the server.
encryption_status.mismatch: R2_ENCRYPTION_KEY does not match the key the credentials were saved with.

settings.encryption_key_missing: Set R2_ENCRYPTION_KEY (openssl rand -hex 32, the same value on server and worker) before saving credentials here.
settings.bucket_hint: Public files: product images and everything else Medusa serves to visitors.
settings.public_url_hint: How the bucket is reached from the browser: the r2.dev URL (R2 → bucket → Settings → Public access) or your custom domain. Without it, public files only get temporary links.
settings.prefix_hint: Optional folder inside the bucket, e.g. medusa. Files are stored as <folder>/<name>-<id>.<ext>.
settings.private_bucket_hint: Optional second bucket, without public access, for files Medusa marks private (exports, imports). Empty: the same bucket.
settings.cache_control_hint: Header stored with every upload. Keys are unique, so a long immutable cache is safe.
settings.download_url_ttl_hint: Lifetime of presigned download links for private files, 60 s to 7 days.
settings.upload_url_ttl_hint: Lifetime of presigned upload links, 60 s to 7 days.
settings.test_ok: Connection OK ({{ms}} ms): bucket reachable, write, read and delete work.
